# Terraform AWS ECR Repositories Management Module




This module manages AWS ECR repositories, providing a streamlined approach to creating, 
configuring, and maintaining container image repositories on AWS. It supports features such as 
lifecycle policies, encryption, repository policies, image scanning, and registry-wide configurations.
Key features include:
- Multiple repository management
- Customizable lifecycle policies
- KMS encryption support
- Image scanning configuration
- Repository and registry IAM policies
- Tag immutability controls


---

This project is part of our comprehensive approach towards DevOps Acceleration.

## Introduction

The AWS ECR Repositories Management Module simplifies the process of creating and managing 
Amazon Elastic Container Registry (ECR) repositories through Infrastructure as Code. It provides 
a comprehensive solution for organizations needing to maintain multiple container image repositories 
with standardized configurations and security policies.

## Usage


**IMPORTANT:** The `master` branch is used in `source` just as an example. In your code, do not pin to `master` because there may be breaking changes between releases.
Instead pin to the release tag (e.g. `?ref=vX.Y.Z`) of one of our [latest releases](https://github.com/cloudopsworks/terraform-module-aws-ecr-repositories/releases).


The module accepts the following main variable structures:

repositories:
  - name: string                 # Repository name
    force_delete: bool           # Allow repository deletion with images
    image_tag_mutability: string # MUTABLE or IMMUTABLE
    encryption_type: string      # AES256 or KMS
    kms_key: string             # KMS key ARN if encryption_type is KMS
    scan_on_push: bool          # Enable scan on push
    lifecycle_policy_rules:      # List of lifecycle policy rules
      - rule_priority: number
        description: string
        selection:
          tag_status: string
          tag_prefix_list: list(string)
          tag_pattern_list: list(string)
          count_type: string
          count_unit: string
          count_number: number
        action:
          type: string
    policy:                      # Repository IAM policy
      statements:
        - sid: string
          effect: string
          actions: list(string)
          resources: list(string)
          conditions:
            - test: string
              values: list(string)
              variable: string

## Quick Start

1. Add the module to your Terragrunt configuration:
   ```hcl
   terraform {
     source = "git::https://github.com/cloudopsworks/terraform-module-aws-ecr-repositories.git?ref=v1.2.8"
   }
   ```

2. Configure basic repository:
   ```hcl
   inputs = {
     repositories = [
       {
         name = "my-first-repo"
         scan_on_push = true
       }
     ]
   }
   ```

3. Apply the configuration:
   ```bash
   terragrunt init
   terragrunt plan
   terragrunt apply
   ```


## Examples

terragrunt.hcl example:
```hcl
include "root" {
  path = find_in_parent_folders()
}

terraform {
  source = "git::https://github.com/cloudopsworks/terraform-module-aws-ecr-repositories.git?ref=v1.2.8"
}

inputs = {
  repositories = [
    {
      name = "app-repository"
      image_tag_mutability = "IMMUTABLE"
      scan_on_push = true
      lifecycle_policy_rules = [
        {
          rule_priority = 1
          description = "Keep last 30 days of images"
          selection = {
            tag_status = "untagged"
            count_type = "sinceImagePushed"
            count_unit = "days"
            count_number = 30
          }
          action = {
            type = "expire"
          }
        }
      ]
    }
  ]

  scanning = {
    scan_type = "ENHANCED"
    rules = [
      {
        scan_frequency = "SCAN_ON_PUSH"
        filter = "*"
        filter_type = "WILDCARD"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```
